questions.prompt: A particle has \(v_{0x}=2\,\mathrm{m\,s^{-1}}\), \(a_x=3\,\mathrm{m\,s^{-2}}\), and \(t=4\,\mathrm{s}\). Find \(v_x\).
A particle starts at \(x_0=0\) with \(v_{0x}=2\,\mathrm{m\,s^{-1}}\) and \(a_x=3\,\mathrm{m\,s^{-2}}\). Find \(x\) at \(t=4\,\mathrm{s}\).
Check the units in \(x=x_0+v_{0x}t+\frac{1}{2}a_xt^2\).
questions.answer:
Each term has units of metres:
\[
v_{0x}t\rightarrow \mathrm{m\,s^{-1}}\cdot\mathrm{s}=\mathrm{m}
\]
\[
a_xt^2\rightarrow \mathrm{m\,s^{-2}}\cdot\mathrm{s^2}=\mathrm{m}
\]

A particle has \(v_{0x}=3\,\mathrm{m\,s^{-1}}\), \(a_x=2\,\mathrm{m\,s^{-2}}\), and \(\Delta x=20\,\mathrm{m}\). Find final speed.
A particle changes velocity from \(3\,\mathrm{m\,s^{-1}}\) to \(15\,\mathrm{m\,s^{-1}}\) in \(6\,\mathrm{s}\). Find the constant acceleration.

questions.answer: It is valid only when acceleration is constant over the time interval being modeled.

questions.prompt: A particle starts from rest and travels \(25\,\mathrm{m}\) with \(a_x=2\,\mathrm{m\,s^{-2}}\). Find the time.
For constant acceleration, a particle changes from \(4\,\mathrm{m\,s^{-1}}\) to \(12\,\mathrm{m\,s^{-1}}\) in \(5\,\mathrm{s}\). Find displacement.
A particle has \(x_0=5\,\mathrm{m}\), \(v_{0x}=-2\,\mathrm{m\,s^{-1}}\), \(a_x=1\,\mathrm{m\,s^{-2}}\), and \(t=6\,\mathrm{s}\). Find \(x\).
If \(v_x>0\) and \(a_x<0\), what happens to speed at that instant?
questions.answer: The signs oppose, so the speed decreases at that instant.
